description: This header file declares functions, structures, and enums for manipulating disk image files used by crosvm and QEMU, including creating composite disks, aggregating images, and generating qcow overlays.

classes.name: ImagePartition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with label, file path, type, and read-only flag.

classes.name: MultipleImagePartition
classes.description: Represents a partition with multiple image file paths, label, type, and read-only flag.

methods.name: AlignToPartitionSize
methods.description: Aligns a given size to the partition size boundary.

methods.name: AggregateImage
methods.description: Combines multiple disk images into a single raw disk file with a GUID Partition Table.

methods.name: CreateCompositeDisk
methods.description: Generates files for a composite disk, including header, footer, and specification files.

methods.name: CreateQcowOverlay
methods.description: Creates a qcow overlay backed by a specified implementation file.
